AI operating system

A solo business with its operations connected.

A personal AIOS connecting context, live data, reusable skills and scheduled n8n operations.

AIOS Personal implementation Where this number comes from

The problem

A one-person business has no operations team, so every process lives in the founder's head. The work still gets done, but only while he remembers to do it, and none of it improves on its own. The bottleneck is not skill or tools, it is that nothing runs unless someone opens a laptop.

What it does

01

Knows the business

Written-down context, the voice, the numbers, the rules and the priorities, so the system answers like a teammate rather than a stranger and nothing depends on re-explaining it.

02

Reaches the real data

Inbox, calendar, CRM, tasks, files and the automation platform itself, all pulled live from the source on demand. Nothing is copied into a second store that goes stale.

03

Produces to a standard

Reusable skills and written procedures for the jobs that recur, so a proposal, a brief or a triaged inbox comes out the same way every time.

04

Handles recurring work

Scheduled n8n operations cover planning, rollover and CRM updates. Their execution and destination evidence are checked separately from publication; drafting tools need their own available host.

How it is built

ContextConnectionsCapabilitiesCadence

Four layers connect business context, live integrations, reusable skills and scheduled operations. n8n handles mechanical work; AI drafting handles tasks needing judgement. A built error handler routes failures for AI diagnosis. Current automatic repair is not claimed without execution and destination proof.

What I'd watch if it were yours

Start with cadence, not with a chatbot

The layer clients actually feel is the scheduled one. A thing that runs at 4am and lands finished on someone's desk changes a week; a chat window they have to remember to open does not.

Record stopped operations

Unneeded routines are deliberately paused. Historical Claude cloud builds are not claimed as currently running. Pausing a component cleanly is a design requirement.

Pull, never copy

Every duplicated fact is a future contradiction. Where two stores could disagree, one is named the winner in writing.

The architecture is documented in the project. Current workflow counts require fresh verification.
